name: a script is formatted as JavaScript
expected:
<script>
  var a = { b: 1, 'c-d': [1, 2, 3] };
  function f(x) {
    return x ? 'yes' : 'no';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-a]').forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      f(el.dataset.a, el.dataset.b, el.dataset.c);
    });
  });
</script>
again:
<script>
  var a = { b: 1, 'c-d': [1, 2, 3] };
  function f(x) {
    return x ? 'yes' : 'no';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-a]').forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      f(el.dataset.a, el.dataset.b, el.dataset.c);
    });
  });
</script>
